function: FL-trained DNN infers route-cost weights and a transmit-power region and beam zone; RIS phases are closed form (Eq. 11); no area 1-7 problem is solved (pp. 1, 6, 12).
notes: Excluded, function. The DNN solves two problems jointly (p. 12: "Problem I: Determine the optimal weight values of the cost function to select the multicast route" and "Problem II: Determine the optimal region and zone for data transmission"). Problem I is routing; Problem II is a transmit-power and beam-sector choice of single-antenna directional APs (p. 4), which the paper assigns to the physical layer, so above_phy is passed by the joint clause. It is not a precoder, beam search or RIS design: RIS phases follow a closed form (p. 6, Eq. 11) and the paper plans multiple antennas as future work (p. 18). Aggregation is digital over a CPU backhaul (pp. 3, 13). If the reviewer does not count Problem II as a physical-layer decision, the code is above_phy. Tables VII and VIII were read from the page image (p. 14).
